description_en: 3+1+2 apartment for sale in Jordan Misja. It is organized by 1 common living and cooking area, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony. The apartment is located on the 8th floor of a building with 2 elevators and a ventilated facade. The apartment is located in a developed area which has access to the main points of the city and has all the facilities for a comfortable life. For more information, contact us.
